models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light N-NE pattern over the Aeolians, seas 1-2.5 ft - but the forecast ends 2 Oct, a day before you sail.
briefing.synopsis: The current picture over the islands is a light northerly-to-northeasterly flow: ECMWF IFS/AIFS (both 26 Sep 06Z) and ICON-2i (26 Sep 12Z) agree on 5-11 kt through 27 Sep, peaking around 10-11 kt at midday on the 26th at Panarea, Stromboli and Salina, with gusts in the mid-to-high teens. Seas are modest - 1.6-2.5 ft total wave and 1.0-2.0 ft swell at the outer islands, less inside Portorosa. From late on 27 Sep the flow collapses: by 28 Sep the consensus is 1-4 kt and waves down to 0.5-0.9 ft everywhere. The model horizon here runs only to 23:00 on 2 Oct, so none of this covers the trip dates and it should be read as pattern, not prediction.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight (26 Sep) the fleet is at Portorosa Marina - enclosed, all-round shelter, and the only listed option, so no decision to make. Local conditions are 5.5 kt from due N at 18:00 with gusts to 13.6 kt and 1.4 ft wave (consensus of IFS 06Z, AIFS 06Z and ICON-2i 12Z), easing overnight to around 5 kt NE. Nothing in the payload suggests a reason to move.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: 27 Sep looks quiet: Portorosa 5.3 kt NNE, gusts 10.9 kt, 1.6 ft wave at 06:00, with Lipari at 9.2 kt NNE - though there the models spread from 5.4 to 14.0 kt, so treat the mean with caution. The rehearsal run scores Portorosa-Lipari a 'go' off a 06:00 departure at 8.7 kt close hauled; that is a dry run against live weather, not your 4 Oct leg. Conditions ease further into 28 Sep, when winds drop to 1-3 kt fleet-wide.

passage_notes.note: Rehearsed 27 Sep: 'go', 06:00, 8.7 kt close hauled. Trip date is beyond the model horizon - no forecast yet.
Rehearsed 28 Sep: 'go' at 2.5 kt broad reach - motoring air. No data for the actual date.
Rehearsed 29 Sep: 'go', 2.1 kt head to wind - a motor. Trip date unforecast.

passage_notes.note: Rehearsed 30 Sep: 'go', 3.2 kt run. Trip date unforecast.
Rehearsed 1 Oct: 'go', 7.3 kt broad reach. Trip date unforecast.
Rehearsed 2 Oct: 'go', 4.6 kt close hauled - the last hour any model reaches. Trip date unforecast.

cautions: The trip runs 4-8 Oct; the forecast reaches only 23:00 on 2 Oct. Every 'go' in this payload is a rehearsal against current weather, not a verdict on your dates.

Where models_range_kt appears the spread is real: Lipari 7.2-14.0 kt (26 Sep 12:00), Panarea 7.4-16.8 kt (27 Sep 06:00), Stromboli 8.4-15.2 kt (27 Sep 00:00), Portorosa 0.5-8.8 kt (28 Sep 00:00). Plan on the top of the range.

Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli scores only 'workable' (0.919) and is open from every direction - shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm. Worth remembering when that optional leg comes into range.
IFS gusts are interval maxima, so the large gust-to-mean ratios in light air (e.g. 9.5 kt gust on 2.3 kt mean at Portorosa, 28 Sep 18:00) overstate what you will feel.
briefing.confidence_note: For the trip dates themselves there is no model data at all; even within the horizon, the stability record shows direction shifting a mean 57° run-to-run at 72-120 h lead, so only the next 24-48 h carries real weight.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
